minutes.headline: Planning Board reviewed peer-review waivers for the new middle/high school site and will get DPW input before July 14.
minutes.summary: The board went through the peer review engineer's letter on the combined middle/high school site plan, covering likely waivers, parking, pavement, drainage and snow storage. It wants the DPW director's feedback and expects to return July 14. It also signed an ANR plan for 174 Northfield Road, discussed a right of first refusal, and scheduled village district bylaw planning and a July 30 charette.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board reviewed the peer review engineer's letter on the combined middle/high school site plan, including likely waivers, parking, pavement, drainage and snow storage.
The chair and the engineer will meet the DPW director on the waivers, and the board will take up the school site plan again at its July 14 meeting.
The board voted to sign an ANR plan dividing two lots at 174 Northfield Road.
The board will tell the Selectmen it has no planning opinion on the 145 Page Street right of first refusal beyond supporting conservation and open space recommendations.
Village district bylaw planning was set for July 14, a charette was set for July 30 at 6 PM, and the Highfield Village hearing was continued without a date.

why_it_matters: Waivers from town bylaws on parking, pavement and drainage at the school site shape what the school project must build and what it costs, and the board's view will come before the project moves on.
The village district bylaw and the July 30 charette are early steps toward a zoning change that residents may later be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
watch_next: July 14: the board returns to the school site plan after hearing from the DPW director, and begins village district bylaw planning at 6:30.
July 30 at 6 PM: the charette, with a walk-around, held here or in the library.
